header.description: Posts on the Discord of {guild} when a creator goes live or publishes (YouTube, Twitch and more).

empty.title: Not following anyone yet
empty.body: Add a YouTube or Twitch creator and the Bot will post here when they publish.

card.testReal: Real alert sent, the creator is live/just posted something!
card.testSimulated: Simulation sent (nothing live/new right now). Check the format in the channel.

removeConfirm.title: Stop following?
removeConfirm.description: Stop alerting about {handle}. Alerts already posted aren't deleted.

errors.contentKinds: Check at least one content type.

editor.subtitle: The Bot posts in this server when the creator publishes the chosen content.

provider.label: 1. Platform
provider.hint: YouTube and Twitch have official detection (push). Kick/TikTok/Instagram are Pro.
provider.immutable: The platform can't change after creation.

handle.label: 2. Creator (@handle)
handle.hint: Paste the creator's @handle or link. The Bot resolves the platform ID when saving.

contentKinds.label: Content types
contentKinds.hint: Only these types trigger an alert.

template.label: 4. Message (optional)
template.hint: Empty = the Bot uses a default message. The Embed editor (MessageDesign V2) is coming to Pro.
